verdict.rationale: Requesty's own docs make official SDK use a supported path: you point the official OpenAI SDK at Requesty's base_url with 'no SDK changes, no new client to learn,' and Claude Code connects through Anthropic environment variables. There is no evidence of a Requesty-branded official SDK, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: a first-party Requesty SDK (or SDKs across languages), SDK reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec for SDK generation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: If you're already using the OpenAI SDK, point it at Requesty and you're done. No SDK changes, no new client to learn.
Requesty is a unified LLM gateway and OpenAI-compatible API for 300+ AI models
